question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Would**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct option to fill in the blank is "would."
 
• In this context, "**would**" is used as a **modal auxiliary verb** to express a future possibility or likelihood.
 
• It suggests a prediction or expectation about the person's ability or inclination to become a ballet dancer.
 
• The use of "**would**" implies a strong conviction or belief about the person's future in ballet dancing.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• "**Ever**" is an adverb used to refer to any time in existence or in one's life. It is often used in questions, negations, and emphatic statements.
 
• "**Can't**" is a contraction of "cannot" and is used to express the inability or impossibility of doing something.
 
• "**Won't**" is a contraction of "will not" and is used to express a future refusal or unwillingness to do something.
